title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #12 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which action shows obedience to school rules? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the compound clean
   B. Leaving without permission
   C. Fighting
   D. Coming late

2. What are the two greatest commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Work and rest
   B. Love God and love your neighbour
   C. Buy and sell
   D. Pray and fast

3. Who is your neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Only people next door
   B. Anyone near you or in need
   C. Only relatives
   D. Only friends

4. Which chore shows responsibility at home? (1 mark)
   A. Breaking plates
   B. Washing plates
   C. Complaining
   D. Hiding

5. Which action honours God with the body? (1 mark)
   A. Using bad words
   B. Taking drugs
   C. Fighting
   D. Keeping clean and eating well

6. Which of these shows respect for others' bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Not hitting or bullying
   B. Bullying
   C. Touching without permission
   D. Hitting

7. What are the two meanings of the word church? (1 mark)
   A. The building and the people of God
   B. A market and a school
   C. A song and a prayer
   D. A river and a hill

8. Which behaviour shows respect for the church? (1 mark)
   A. Running
   B. Entering quietly
   C. Shouting
   D. Littering

9. What did the first Christians devote themselves to? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Travel
   C. Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   D. Trading

10. What does the word apostle mean? (1 mark)
   A. A fisher
   B. One who is sent
   C. A king
   D. One who sits

11. Antioch lies north of Jerusalem. In which direction would you travel from Jerusalem to reach Antioch? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. South
   D. West

12. Who was stoned for standing firm in his faith? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. Stephen
   C. Paul
   D. Andrew

13. Why does the prayer use "our" and "us"? (1 mark)
   A. We pray together and for others
   B. Only for adults
   C. Only for priests
   D. It is a mistake

14. The Lord's Prayer can be grouped into praise, provision, pardon and protection. Which idea is about forgiving and being forgiven? (1 mark)
   A. Pardon
   B. Provision
   C. Praise
   D. Protection

15. Which fruit is shown by making peace between quarrelling friends? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Pride
   C. Laziness
   D. Peace

16. How many fruits of the Spirit are listed? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Nine
   C. Twelve
   D. Five

17. Which decision step comes first? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and think
   B. Copy others
   C. Ask nobody
   D. Choose quickly

18. Which verses in Galatians speak of self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Acts 2:1
   C. Galatians 5:22-25
   D. Genesis 1:1

19. Which of these should you not share? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible verse
   B. A gospel song
   C. A school notice
   D. Private pictures of yourself

20. Which number can children call for help in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 200
   C. 66
   D. 116

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how a child can show any five fruits of the Spirit in daily life. (5 marks)

22. Describe how Stephen died. (3 marks)

23. Explain what a child should do if a stranger contacts them online and why. (5 marks)

24. Explain what a child should do if they are offered drugs or asked to do something that defiles the body. (5 marks)

25. State two ways of glorifying God with our bodies. (2 marks)

26. Outline three results of disobedience. (3 marks)

27. Explain why young people should lead holy lives, and give four ways of doing it. (5 marks)

28. State two benefits of obeying parents. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Keeping the compound clean
   Following rules shows responsibility.

2. B — Love God and love your neighbour
   Matthew 22:37-39.

3. B — Anyone near you or in need
   A neighbour is anyone we can help.

4. B — Washing plates
   Doing chores shows duty.

5. D — Keeping clean and eating well
   Care for the body honours God.

6. A — Not hitting or bullying
   We respect others as God's creation.

7. A — The building and the people of God
   Church means the building and the community.

8. B — Entering quietly
   Quiet respect honours God's house.

9. C — Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   Acts 2:42.

10. B — One who is sent
   Apostles were sent out with a message.

11. A — North
   To reach a place that lies to the north, you travel north.

12. B — Stephen
   Acts 7:54-60.

13. A — We pray together and for others
   The prayer reminds us to think of others.

14. A — Pardon
   Pardon means forgiveness.

15. D — Peace
   Peace is a fruit.

16. B — Nine
   There are nine.

17. A — Stop and think
   Stopping helps you decide well.

18. C — Galatians 5:22-25
   Galatians 5:22-25.

19. D — Private pictures of yourself
   Never share private pictures.

20. D — 116
   Childline Kenya.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing; joy: thanking God; peace: stopping quarrels; patience: waiting your turn; kindness: helping others; goodness: honesty; faithfulness: keeping promises; gentleness: speaking softly; self-control: walking away from a fight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with an example, up to 5.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: The people were furious at his message, dragged him out of the city and stoned him. He prayed for God to receive his spirit and to forgive them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for anger, 1 for stoning, 1 for prayer.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: They should not reply, should close the chat, should tell a parent or teacher, and can call 116. Strangers may pretend to be someone else and may want to harm the child. Telling a trusted adult keeps the child safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not replying, 1 for closing, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for the helpline, 1 for the reason.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, walk away, avoid the group, tell a trusted adult such as a parent or teacher, pray for strength, and choose friends who make good choices.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying no, 1 for walking away, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for prayer, 1 for good friends.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep clean and healthy, speak kindly, avoid harmful things, use hands to help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is holy and asks us to be holy. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit. A holy life keeps us safe and pleases God. Ways: keep clean, avoid drugs and alcohol, choose good friends, avoid harmful media, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's call, 1 for the temple idea, 1 for safety, 2 for ways.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit.
